case.message: Compare Apple annual revenue and net income before and after November 10, 2023. Explain whether management outlook passages can actually be tested using the retrieved financial metrics.

data.response:
# Apple Annual Revenue and Net Income Investigation

**Insufficient evidence**

Apple reported annual revenue of $394,328,000,000 and net income of $99,803,000,000 for the fiscal year ended September 24, 2022 [E235ad68993](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019322000108/0000320193-22-000108-index.html) [E9c6a2ce778](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019322000108/0000320193-22-000108-index.html), and revenue of $383,285,000,000 with net income of $96,995,000,000 for the fiscal year ended September 30, 2023 [Ec6ae530bde](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019323000106/0000320193-23-000106-index.html) [E1ce95e651e](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019323000106/0000320193-23-000106-index.html). For the fiscal year ended September 28, 2024, revenue was $391,035,000,000 and net income was $93,736,000,000 [E41e35d321d](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019324000123/0000320193-24-000123-index.html) [Eecea98d14c](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019324000123/0000320193-24-000123-index.html). Management outlook passages cannot be tested because no matching records were retrieved from the date-bounded source for AAPL claims as of November 10, 2023 [E6821590ed0].

## Numbers on record

AAPL revenue for the fiscal period ended 2024-09-28 was $391.035 billion [E41e35d321d](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019324000123/0000320193-24-000123-index.html), up from $383.285 billion for 2023-09-30 [Ec6ae530bde](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019323000106/0000320193-23-000106-index.html). AAPL net income for the fiscal period ended 2024-09-28 was $93.736 billion [Eecea98d14c](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019324000123/0000320193-24-000123-index.html), down from $96.995 billion for 2023-09-30 [E1ce95e651e](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019323000106/0000320193-23-000106-index.html). AAPL cash PP&E purchases for the fiscal period ended 2024-09-28 was $9.447 billion [E4bdeb09bc5](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019324000123/0000320193-24-000123-index.html), down from $10.959 billion for 2023-09-30 [Ef7a990576f](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019323000106/0000320193-23-000106-index.html).

## What was knowable then

As of November 10, 2023, Apple had filed its annual report for the fiscal year ended September 30, 2023, reporting revenue of $383,285,000,000 and net income of $96,995,000,000 [Ec656fbf4a2](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019322000108/0000320193-22-000108-index.html) [E238a478f82](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019323000106/0000320193-23-000106-index.html). For the prior fiscal year ended September 24, 2022, Apple reported revenue of $394,328,000,000 and net income of $99,803,000,000 [Ec656fbf4a2](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019322000108/0000320193-22-000108-index.html) [E4107e5b169](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019322000108/0000320193-22-000108-index.html). No matching records were retrieved under the supported tags or search for management claims as of November 10, 2023 [E6821590ed0].

## What happened later

For the fiscal year ended September 28, 2024, Apple subsequently reported revenue of $391,035,000,000 and net income of $93,736,000,000 [E41e35d321d](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019324000123/0000320193-24-000123-index.html) [Eecea98d14c](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019324000123/0000320193-24-000123-index.html). Operating income for the same period was reported at $123,216,000,000 alongside operating cash flow of $118,254,000,000 and capital expenditures of $9,447,000,000 [E8cdbc41d29](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019324000123/0000320193-24-000123-index.html) [E0900aed9c6](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019324000123/0000320193-24-000123-index.html) [E4bdeb09bc5](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019324000123/0000320193-24-000123-index.html).

## The peer test

Only AAPL was selected. Add a peer company to compare results.

## Cross-examination

Management outlook passages cannot be tested using the retrieved financial metrics because no relevant management claims or guidance data were retrieved from the date-bounded source as of the November 10, 2023 as-of date [E6821590ed0]. Consequently, any comparison of subsequent financial results to management expectations remains unsupported by evidence.

## Limits

- No peer companies beyond AAPL were requested or evaluated in the scope.
- No matching records in the date-bounded source for AAPL claims as of November 10, 2023.
